notes:
Account summary: Cypress Sentinel is a European financial data platform that wants a private VPC deployment for inference. Primary driver is regulatory compliance + forensic auditability. Heavy cost sensitivity but will pay for provable controls and long-term retention.

Recent activity:
- 2026-02-18 intro call (Priya, Daniel) — high-level requirements captured; asked for SIEM export options. Fireflies id ff_2026-02-18_01c3b9.
- 2026-02-25 security questionnaire submitted (SAML, SOC2, ISO docs requested).
- 2026-03-01 network diagram received (VPN + Transit VPC, strict egress rules).
- 2026-03-05 follow-up meeting — asked for log schema and retention plan; legal wants 7-year archival + 90d hot logs.
- NDA signed 2026-02-10.

Use-case & tech requirements (from SE call):
- Workloads: customer support chat (PII), document search across contracts, automated summarization for compliance teams.
- Latency: tail P95 < 300ms for short-chat flows; bulk rerank jobs can be batched.
- Throughput: expected 500 qps peak across dedicated pool.
- Model preferences: fine-tuned open model family; ability to route to small/fast variant for interactive paths and higher-quality for batch.

Audit logging & SIEM requirements (detailed asks):
- Export targets: Splunk and internal SIEM (Elastic + Kafka ingestion). Acceptable transport: secure syslog over TLS, native Splunk HEC, or S3 push for batch archival. Also asked about Kafka topic forwarding into their security pipeline.
- Required fields (must map exactly to their schema): timestamp (ISO8601), request_id, tenant_id, user_id (hashed for PII), client_ip, model, model_variant, prompt_hash, input_tokens, output_tokens, latency_ms, node_id, action (generate/embed/rerank), decision (served/fallback), fallback_reason, kv_cache_hit (bool), quant_profile, encryption_key_id, response_signature (optional).
- Log schema expectations: JSON lines, CEF mapping for legacy tools, sample mapping required for Splunk HEC ingestion. They requested a canonical schema + example events for security review.
- Retention: Hot logs 90 days (searchable), warm 2 years, cold archival 7 years (WORM where possible). Legal insists on tamper-evident storage for archival logs.
- Access logs: admin console access events, API key creation/rotation, service account usage, role changes, and IP allowlist modifications. Must include who/when/what and link to supporting request id.
- Audit trail guarantees: append-only, write-once backup for archives, signed events preferred. They asked if Redwood supports signed/hashed chain of custody for events (customer-provided HSM integration desirable).
- KMS integration: require customer-managed keys (AWS KMS; prefer multi-region CMKs), support for key rotation without re-encrypting historical logs (envelope encryption + key-id tagging), and HSM-backed signing for response_signature field. Also want proof of zero-access by Redwood support (KMS keys not exportable).
- SIEM sampling & volume controls: must support sampling for high-throughput events (configurable rate and sampling keys) and a separate debug-log stream for POC.

Security review status & asks outstanding:
- Cypress SecOps completed initial questionnaire; pending items: detailed log schema, SIEM forwarder architecture diagram, KMS key lifecycle doc, and playback test for archived logs.
- Pen test: Cypress requests Redwood's latest penetration test report and prefers a 3rd-party test prior to go-live.

POC plan proposed by SE (short):
1) Spin up private VPC with test tenant + CMK stub.
2) Deliver SIEM-forwarder POC that writes canonical logs to Splunk HEC + Kafka.
3) Provide sample events and mapping to their schema for sign-off.
4) Run retention/archival exercise showing WORM archival to S3 and retrieval latency.

Sales notes / messaging tips for AE:
- Emphasize support for BYOK via AWS KMS and HSM signing for non-repudiation.
- Provide concrete log schema example; map Redwood fields to their SIEM CEF standards.
- Offer a short-runner POC focused only on audit pipeline to unblock legal.

Next steps / owner action items:

- AE (Priya) to coordinate KMS policy review with Cypress legal; provide key escrow and rotation docs.
- Schedule SIEM-forwarder POC slot for week of 2026-03-24 (Cypress availability confirmed).
